_note: Fires and fountains that move in the story worlds (src/vfx/fire_anim.gd, built from the loaded sprites of every graphics set). frames = pictures per loop, fps = loop speed (each fire starts at its own point, so they do not flicker in step). fire: names = the sprites whose flames flicker; a flame pixel is bright (lum) and coloured (sat), or a near-white core (core_lum) next to one, so stone, wood and snow stay still; band = brightness swing of the light bands rising through the flame, band_k = bands per px of height, tip = share of the flame's top edge pixels that fade in and out (the flame licks), tip_rows = how deep that edge reaches (px). water: names = the sprites whose water flows; a water pixel is blue (blue over red by blue_over, at least blue_min) and coloured (sat); band and band_k as for fire, the bands run down, sparkle = share of bright glints.
